summary: Aspire Biopharma Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a Delaware Certificate of Amendment, effective September 8, 2026, changing its corporate name to Aspire-Lakewood Holdings, Inc. No stockholder approval was required under DGCL Sections 212 and 242 because the amendment solely effected a name change. The common stock continues trading on Nasdaq under the same symbol, ASPB, with the same CUSIP, and existing certificates and book-entry positions remain valid with no holder action needed. A related press release was furnished. This is a routine administrative charter amendment and name change, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation are implicated, and the risk-arb angle is nil.
